verdict.rationale: SumUp's Cloud API explicitly lets a POS on any platform drive Solo/Go readers via HTTPS requests from the backend, with docs covering pairing, multi-reader support, sandbox/virtual testing, and offline transactions, plus community evidence of a real developer building a custom integration against the public API. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and more independent hands-on validation beyond one HN anecdote.
